t: Tourism in Bilbao. What to see | spain.info
s: You can buy a single ticket or use the Barik travel card. There are eight night buses, known as Gautxori, which operate between 11 p.m. and 2:30 a.m. on Fridays and throughout the night on Saturdays. There are also coach stops in the city, with routes between Bilbao and nearby towns.
